candidates.change_summary: Return the zero address instead of the stored _owner by replacing the body to always return address(0).
Removed the guard that prevents transferring ownership to the zero address by deleting the require check, allowing transferOwnership(address(0)) to set owner to zero.
Changed the visibility guard so anyone can call transferOwnership by removing onlyOwner modifier, allowing non-owner callers to change owner.
Weakened the onlyOwner check to compare against tx.origin instead of msg.sender, changing who is authorized to call transferOwnership.
Inverted the onlyOwner check to require the caller NOT be the owner, allowing only non-owners to execute owner-only functions such as transferOwnership.
